claim: Defines a transfer-learning domain as the two-tuple of feature space X and its marginal probability distribution P(X).
Defines a transfer-learning task as the two-tuple of label space Y and the predictor function P(y|x).
States the domain-similarity condition of the usual learning setting: source and target marginal distributions are equal.
States the task-similarity condition of the usual learning setting: source and target conditional distributions are equal.
States the task-dissimilarity condition of inductive transfer learning: source and target conditional distributions differ.
States the domain-dissimilarity condition of transductive transfer learning: source and target marginal distributions differ.
